Working within a friendly and supportive team, you'll play a key role in supporting customer service, sales administration and wider commercial activities across a portfolio of well-established brands.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous administration, sales support or customer service experience who enjoys a fast-paced environment and wants to develop their career within a successful business.

The Role

As a Sales Administrator, you'll support the day-to-day running of the commercial function, ensuring customers receive an excellent experience while helping the wider team deliver efficient sales and operational processes.

Key responsibilities include:

Sales Administration
- Processing customer orders and updating information within SAP and online ordering systems.
- Managing customer backorders and proactively chasing outstanding orders.
- Producing warehouse pick lists to support daily dispatch activities.
- Supporting online order fulfilment and coordinating deliveries.

Customer Service & Support
- Acting as the first point of contact for customer enquiries, providing professional telephone and email support.
- Ensuring customer requests are handled promptly and professionally.
- Processing returns and supporting aftersales activities.

Systems & Business Support
- Maintaining accurate customer information across business systems.
- Supporting SAP, CRM and website data maintenance.
- Uploading pricing information and managing system updates.
- Liaising with external software and IT providers when required.

Marketing & Commercial Support
- Assisting with customer communications and marketing campaigns.
- Supporting promotional activities, events and customer visits.
- Providing wider commercial support and contributing to business improvement projects.

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, professional and enjoys working with both customers and colleagues.

You'll ideally have:
- Experience in a Sales Administrator, Sales Support, Customer Service, Commercial Administration or Business Support role.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Confident communication skills with a professional approach.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, including Excel and Word.
- The ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks effectively.
- A positive, flexible and team-focused attitude.

Experience of SAP or a similar ERP system would be beneficial but is not essential, as full training will be provided.

You don't need automotive experience to be successful in this role. We're looking for somebody with the right attitude, strong organisational skills and a genuine desire to learn.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 29,000 - 35,000, depending on experience.
- Genuine career development opportunities.
- Ongoing training and support.
- A varied and interesting role with plenty of scope to grow.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Early finish every Friday.
- Generous holiday entitlement.
- Opportunity to join a successful and expanding business.

title: HR Operations Coordinator
description:
Our client is a global employer, seeking a proactive and highly organised HR Operations Coordinator to support HR operations across various global regions. This varied role is ideal for an experienced HR support professional with strong payroll and HR administration expertise who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment. You will play a key role in ensuring payroll accuracy, maintaining employee records, supporting employee benefits administration, coordinating onboarding and offboarding activities, and providing first-class support to employees and internal stakeholders.

Duties & Responsibilities
- Oversee end-to-end UK payroll, including salaries, bonuses, commissions, deductions and pension administration.
- Coordinate payroll data for other global entities, liaising with external payroll providers and validating payroll calculations before processing.
- Ensure payroll transactions, employee changes, new starters and leavers are processed accurately and on time.
- Administer employee benefits, supporting enrolments, amendments, renewals and employee communications across applicable regions.
- Act as the first point of contact for payroll and benefits queries, delivering an excellent employee experience.
- Prepare employment contracts, contractual amendment letters and manage onboarding and offboarding processes.
- Maintain accurate HR records and databases, produce management reports and ensure compliance with local employment legislation.
- Work closely with HR and Finance teams to reconcile payroll data, improve processes and support HR operational activities.

Education & Skills Required
- Previous experience within HR operations, payroll and HR administration.
- Strong knowledge of payroll processes and employee benefits administration.
- Excellent organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Experience working with HR systems and maintaining employee records.
- Good understanding of employment legislation and payroll compliance requirements across multiple regions.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across all levels of the business.

If you have the skills and experience to thrive in a busy international HR environment and are looking for your next career opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to become part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation.
